about: Owner-visible inventory for the shipped Glide checkout. Test references describe existing source coverage, not execution receipts or native acceptance. Empty tests are uncovered. Army receipts are external and must match HEAD for strict promotion. Text-plugin /glide verbs are not all handled by the native card interceptor.

features.title: Install the combined Tern and Glide plugin
features.entry: hermes plugins install kvnloo/glide, then enable glide
features.expect: One install registers hermes tern and /glide; scanner consent is explicit

features.title: Launch native chat in a Tern pane
features.entry: hermes tern [session and prompt flags]
features.expect: A native chat attaches to Hermes; a non-TSP terminal visibly refuses

features.title: Launch Glide with the available frontend
features.entry: hermes glide
features.expect: The launcher selects Tern when available and the regular TUI otherwise

features.title: Run guided memory onboarding from the CLI
features.entry: hermes glide onboard
features.expect: Build, review, and self-test corrections memory in the active profile

features.title: Choose or switch a frontend channel
features.entry: hermes tern --channel NAME or hermes tern switch NAME
features.expect: The pane runs the selected frontend channel; configured CLI aliases use their channel

features.title: Resume the conversation after a pane restart
features.entry: Restart hermes tern in the same pane without session flags; use --new to opt out
features.expect: The same pane restores its stored session rather than silently starting over

features.title: Send a prompt and read the streamed answer
features.entry: Type in the composer and press Enter or native Send
features.expect: The prompt and streamed thinking, tools, and answer appear in the current transcript

features.title: Complete commands, skills, and references
features.entry: Type / or a supported reference prefix, then use Tab or Enter in completion
features.expect: Matching completion fills the composer; ambiguous command prefixes ask for more text

features.title: Inspect this machine before onboarding
features.entry: /glide; gateway glide.detect; text-plugin /glide help, -h, or --help shows usage
features.expect: Hardware, optional runtimes, z0 health, and memory status appear without installation

features.title: Approve building or refreshing corrections memory
features.entry: Tap Build memory or Refresh after /glide; glide.sync; text-plugin /glide build
features.expect: A bounded recent eligible-session scan excludes the caller and reports counts

features.title: Opt in to quoting corrections
features.entry: Tap Turn on after memory build; glide.enable with on:true; text-plugin /glide on
features.expect: A receipt confirms recall is enabled; text mode refuses an unbuilt store without a reader

features.title: Inspect corrections matching a query
features.entry: /glide recall WORDS; gateway glide.recall
features.expect: Matching history or an honest no-match result appears; z0 matches take precedence when available

features.title: Turn automatic quoting off
features.entry: /glide off; glide.enable with on:false
features.expect: The receipt reports quoting off without deleting the derived store

features.title: Quote matching corrections into an opted-in turn
features.entry: Send a matching prompt after enabling the pre_llm_call hook
features.expect: Up to three past corrections enter context as history; current instructions still win

features.title: Run the text plugin's guided first-run flow
features.entry: In a text Hermes frontend, /glide setup
features.expect: The plugin builds memory, shows retained corrections, and self-tests recall

features.title: Use card verbs on cores without plugin methods
features.entry: command.dispatch glide with arg json VERB PARAMS; text-plugin /glide json VERB PARAMS
features.expect: The same checked operation returns JSON bound to the caller's session

features.title: Approve the native skill catalog step
features.entry: /glide router, then Install; gateway glide.skill_router
features.expect: A local category-to-skills catalog receipt appears; no referenced skill is installed

features.title: Install or replace the text plugin's skill catalog
features.entry: In a text Hermes frontend, /glide skill-router install [--force]
features.expect: The profile stores ranking metadata, or reports the catalog is already installed

features.title: List catalog categories or a category's skills

features.expect: The stored category and skill metadata appears

features.title: Rank catalog skills for a query
features.entry: In a text Hermes frontend, /glide skill-router rank WORDS
features.expect: Deterministic matching returns ranked skill metadata without a model call

features.title: Approve one paired benchmark round
features.entry: /glide climb, then Run one round; glide.hill_climb with run:true
features.expect: The metric card reports baseline, candidate, noise, and KEEP, REVERT, or INCONCLUSIVE

features.title: Create the text plugin's benchmark configuration
features.entry: In a text Hermes frontend, /glide hill-climb scaffold [--force]
features.expect: The local kernel configuration and state are created explicitly

features.title: Run a configured text-plugin benchmark round

features.expect: Intended to print the round and verdict; native card coverage does not certify this text formatter

features.title: Inspect recorded benchmark state

features.title: Clear the offload accounting ledger
